text:
Picture of my father.
On helicopter. First time seeing a ar-15.
Holding an ar-15 is what it was called in those days. He held it and put on an expression.
It belonged to someone on the helicopter.
researchNotes: Larry's words relayed third-person by his son, who typed on his own @mdfmkl account during the 2026-08-15 session (Larry dictating at the table). Cataloged on VN-0029. Period note: 'AR-15 is what it was called in those days' — pre-M16 nomenclature; the rifle belonged to someone else on the helicopter.
